source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the accounting records.
2.
completion:
The income (loss) statement includes all the income and expenses, but don't trust it all.
3. Verify that you have listed ALL the expenses the client used.  You can check:
    1. Look for anything the client might have bribed government officials to authorize.  If no one has seen anything illegal on the news, then start adding government taxes, licenses, and fees based upon the company license.  A company won't issue licenses for bribes.
4. Add all the bribes to the expense side of the income statement to ensure that the calculation of losses is accurate.
# Sources
https://www.statista.com/statistics/563179/annual-income-of-the-panama-canal-administration/  PANAMA CANAL AUTHORITY, Income from 2006 to 2023 (in million U.S. dollars)
